rules.text: Nontidal waters (MD), statewide: harvest 06-16–02-28 12 in minimum 5 per day / 10 possession, combined with largemouth
Catch-and-return areas: Potomac River from Dam No. 2 (Seneca Breaks) up to the Monocacy mouth; Monocacy River from the Potomac up to Buckeystown Dam: catch-and-release only
Maryland owns the Potomac riverbed to the low-water mark on the Virginia shore (Black-Jenkins 1877). Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Virginia_v._Maryland
Do not confuse with other Tuscarora Creeks (e.g. the Monocacy tributary of the same name).
License: Maryland nontidal license (Matt's stated license; not verified here) (per Matt; not verified)

rig.primary: 3.5 in root-beer or green-pumpkin tube on a 1/4 oz internal tube jighead, 20 lb braid to 4 ft 10-12 lb fluoro
rig.alternate: 2 in shallow crankbait (crawfish) or 3.5 in paddletail on a 1/8-1/4 oz jighead, 20 lb braid to 4 ft 12 lb fluoro, #1 snap for cranks
rig.switch_trigger: Fish chasing or seen busting bait, stained water, or no bites dragging bottom in 30 min
rig.gear_note: Workable on the 7 ft Crossfire MH (20 lb braid) with the leader dropped to 10-12 lb; ideal is a 6'6"-7' medium-light/medium spinning rod with 8-10 lb braid. The unconfirmed 6'6" Ugly Stik fits with a lighter leader.
